dedupe_keys.name: mars express processed thermal power telemetry

description: The Mars Express telemetry research team and ESA publish processed spacecraft context and thermal-power measurements as six CSV datasets. Own component pages cover 22 August 2008 to 1 March 2016, described as four Martian years, at resolutions of 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes. Every inspected component is free under CC0. The collection supports prediction, anomaly detection and spacecraft-health studies for an orbiter operating around Mars. It can calibrate power-demand components in spacecraft simulations that use model-orekit for orbital context, and complements the distinct ESA benchmark data-esa-collision-avoidance-challenge-cdm-dataset. A caveat is that the article abstract reports three Martian years, so this record retains the explicit repository dates, not resolving the discrepancy from downloaded values. The six files are alternative temporal representations, not six independent spacecraft histories. No telemetry file or complete numerical schema was downloaded.
